run_download_nevis_dataset: run the script to download and validate a Nevis dataset by name and version
run_load_dataset_from_path: run the script to load and validate a Nevis dataset from a local directory path
run_check_dataset_integrity: run the script to iterate through all splits and verify dataset integrity
run_inspect_dataset_metadata: run the script to print dataset metadata including splits, num classes, and image shape
run_list_dataset_splits: run the script to list and iterate over all available splits for a given dataset
